description: This file implements the DataElementFile class, which manages memory-mapped file operations including opening, closing, reallocation, and synchronization across different platforms (Windows and POSIX). It handles file mapping, cache updates, and resource management for file-based data elements within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: DataElementFile
classes.description: A class that manages memory-mapped file operations, including opening, closing, reallocating, and syncing files across different operating systems.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the file and maps it into memory if not already open.

methods.name: OpenMemoryMappedFile
methods.description: Opens and maps the file into memory with the specified size, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Unmaps and closes the memory-mapped file, releasing resources.

methods.name: Reallocation
methods.description: Reallocates the memory-mapped file to a new size, handling platform-specific remapping.

methods.name: Sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the memory-mapped file with the underlying file, flushing changes.
